fit_metric_boundary.summary: Run_11 may be described only as the best obtained rigid alignment under the evaluated setup. The carried-forward reported fit metric worsened monotonically, but true ICP divergence or successful convergence is unsupported.

coverage_context.interpretation: Whole-network structural metrics must be interpreted under partial overlap and a large coverage mismatch; they do not isolate matched-area local registration quality.

dem_context.note: DEM application must not be claimed for the governed thesis-analysis artifact.

safe_thesis_wording.run11_structural_result: Run_11 should be described as the best obtained rigid alignment under a 2D planView structural comparison with partial overlap and a large coverage mismatch, not as a globally well-registered full-network match.
safe_thesis_wording.icp_refinement_statement: The reported run_11 fit metric worsened monotonically, but that reported metric is not proven equivalent to the ICP objective; the safe thesis statement is only that ICP refinement showed no improvement under the reported metric and does not support a successful-convergence claim.
safe_thesis_wording.dem_statement: DEM integration exists in the pipeline design, but the governed thesis-analysis auto XODR remained flat; DEM elevation must not be claimed for that artifact.
